title: Russia's Ballistic Missiles and Jet-Powered Drones Maintain Sustained Pressure on Ukrainian Infrastructure
detail: Analysis details how Russia's combination of ballistic missiles and jet-powered one-way drones has maintained sustained pressure on Ukrainian infrastructure, adapting tactics to overwhelm air defenses. The strategy involves coordinated waves designed to exhaust Ukrainian interceptor stockpiles and degrade critical energy and defense systems.

media.caption: Russia's missile and drone tactics maintaining pressure on Ukrainian infrastructure
